title: Preview of a profile change (?dry_run=true)
description: Answer of every profile, assignment, adjustment, own-area, default-profile and bulk write with ?dry_run=true (preview before saving): nothing is saved; per affected device the effective values before and after (resolver), the adjustments that would be deleted and the consequences for the HA key and remote access. Without dry_run the same write saves and answers with its normal body; the audit entry contains before/after. Remote PINs (profile or device) never appear in a preview, a diff or the audit.

loosened_rules.description: Rules loosened on at least one device (confirmation needed).

loosens.description: after is looser than before for a critical/sensitive rule (along order; areas: more areas) → confirmation with loosening_warning.

changes.description: Only rules whose effective value or source changes.

overrides_removed.description: Adjustments that would be deleted (rule becomes fixed or the new profile fixes it).

ha_key.description: removed: the device stops holding a Home Assistant key (control_path hub without remote access) → the HA token leaves the device, it reads and switches only through the hub; restored: it holds a key again → it gets its own HA token again.

hub_remote_now.description: Right after this state the device's effective Home Assistant access is Hub only and its remote access is on: it holds the read-only key because of remote access (the admin page warns). Never true on tvos, android_tv, watchos or wearos (Hub only resolves to checked there). Missing on older hubs = unknown.

hub_remote_at.description: The earliest later end (UTC) of a device adjustment or of the guest access after which the device becomes Hub only with remote access; null when hub_remote_now is true or no end leads there.

devices.description: Devices the change leaves unchanged may be listed when the change alters their pair (hub_remote_now, hub_remote_at), both computed before and after the change at the same moment; such an entry has changes [], overrides_removed [], ha_key and remote_access unchanged, and does not count in affected_count.

scene_hints.description: PATCH /api/profiles/{profile_id}?dry_run=true only: the scene hints of the draft (rest/profile.json scene_hints), as they would be after saving.

watches_removed.description: Watches the write removes: a child's watch whose phone may no longer have one. Missing = none. An adult's watch is never removed by a write; it follows its phone (limited_by_phone).
